items.text: OpenAlex (https://openalex.org), searched through the OpenAlex API's OQL interface (https://api.openalex.org), corpus: core (OpenAlex's default set of works).
Not applicable: one database (OpenAlex) was searched by this tool.
This tool searches no study registries. List any registries searched separately.
Describe any online or print sources searched or browsed outside this tool.

Citation searching was used during strategy development: 1 batch(es) of OpenAlex citation links (1 citing) from 1 development work(s), with 7 candidate decision(s) recorded and 4 included. These informed the strategy; they are not a separate set of records in this report. The links are OpenAlex's matched references, as of 2026-11-26: about 82% of references to works in OpenAlex are linked, unmatched references are dropped and many records carry no reference list (OpenAlex documentation, November 2026); OpenAlex revised its links on 25 November 2026, so a rerun on another date can differ. If the optional no-abstract rescue (`rescue`) is run, report it here as a supplementary citation search, with its manifest.
State whether authors, experts or others were contacted for additional studies or data.
1 random-sample pilot(s) of candidate queries were screened during development to check precision and terminology; they were not a source of records. Report any other methods.
The OpenAlex search exactly as run is under 'Search as executed' and in final-query.oql (OQL) and final-query.json (the OpenAlex query object), executed with include_pulled=false.

Limits applied: publication date 2015-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Corpus: core (OpenAlex's default set of works). Pulled works: retracted, withdrawn and removed works excluded (include_pulled=false, OpenAlex's default view). Scope decision recorded at approval: "Reviewer approved delivery and setting search blocks, outcomes at screening, core corpus, pulled excluded, 2015-2025 window.". Confirm that it justifies each limit.
The tool builds no published search filter into the strategy. State whether any block reproduces or adapts a published filter, and cite it.
State whether search strategies from earlier reviews were adapted or reused, and cite them.

To update, rerun final-query.json against the OpenAlex API (POST https://api.openalex.org/ with the query object and include_pulled=false), or rerun `report` in this workspace. A rerun searches the live index on that date, so counts can change. State the update method actually used.
OpenAlex was last searched on 2026-11-26 (at 07:07:50 UTC).
An internal PRESS-structured critique (six domains) was recorded on 2026-11-26. It is not formal peer review; describe any human peer review of the search.
OpenAlex: 4,280 records on 2026-11-26. Add the records identified from each other source.

Within OpenAlex, records are unique by OpenAlex Work ID; `export` deduplicates by Work ID, including across the optional rescue queries. Describe the process and software used to deduplicate records across databases and other sources.
